notes.title: Now available Abi and the soul
notes.content:
[b]Now available Abi and the soul[/b]

Enjoy this wonderful story of love and friendship. Abi and the soul available on steam.

Don't forget to follow us on the Steam developer page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/PGEntertainment]PGEntertainment[/url]

Thank you for all the support you have given us until today.
Abi loves you, and so do we ♥

notes.title: FREE DEMO FOR THE STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.content:
[b]FREE DEMO FOR THE STEAM NEXT FEST[/b]

The Abi and the soul demo will be available 100% free during Steam Next Fest week.

We want to take the opportunity to hear from fans about how Abi and the soul is developing. Any comment on its development, bug reports, gameplay, will be more than welcome.

You cannot miss the opportunity to know this fantastic story of love and friendship.

Abi and the soul demo - Available October 1st completely FREE!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/PGEntertainment]Follow our developer page to find out all the news.[/url]
